name: Esztergályhorváti (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of yellow over blue, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Esztergályhorváti (a blue and green shield with a sun, a fish and a yellow tree, between ears of grain and a bough) above the name ESZTERGÁLYHORVÁTI in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Esztergályhorváti arms with grain and bough
